content.question: How does Apriori search for frequent itemsets?
options: It uses depth-first search over transaction ID lists.
It builds a frequent-pattern tree and applies divide-and-conquer.
It uses breadth-first search, expanding 1-itemsets to 2-itemsets, 3-itemsets and so on while pruning candidates below the minimum support threshold.
It randomly samples itemsets until their support stops changing.
content.answer: It uses breadth-first search, expanding 1-itemsets to 2-itemsets, 3-itemsets and so on while pruning candidates below the minimum support threshold.
